proposal.name: com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core
proposal.rationale: The component name "jackson-core" with no group resolves to com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-core in Maven (E1). The declared version "3.1.6" is unsatisfiable — no such version exists; the latest is 2.23.0 (E4). The root artifact io.vertx:vertx-core:5.1.7 resolves jackson-core to 2.21.6 via its parent dependencyManagement chain (E3), and another component in the same SBOM confirms this version (pkg:maven/com.fasterxml.jackson.core/jackson-core@2.21.6). The "3.1.6" value is therefore a corrupted version field, and the true version is 2.21.6.
